FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(JITRA-SUNGAI DUA (BUTTERWORTH) EXPRESSWAY)

(AMENDMENT) ORDER 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Federal

Roads (Private Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the following

order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (Jitra-Sungai Dua (Butterworth) Expressway) (Amendment)

Order 2020.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 February 2020.

Amendment of paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls) (Jitra-Sungai Dua

(Butterworth)) Expressway Order 1993 [P.U. (A) 229/1993], which is referred to as the

"principal Order" in this Order, is amended in subparagraph 2(1) by substituting for the

words "12 January 2012 to 31 December 2038" the words "1 February 2020

to 31 December 2058".

Substitution of First Schedule

3. The principal Order is amended by substituting for the First Schedule the

following Schedule:

"FIRST SCHEDULE

[Subparagraph 2(1)]

RATES OF TOLL FOR THE PERIOD FROM 1 FEBRUARY 2020

UNTIL 31 DECEMBER 2058

(1)

Classes of Vehicles

(2)

Toll Payable

(RM)

1. Vehicles with two axles and three or four wheels

(excluding taxis and buses)

1.31

(excluding buses)

2.30

3. Vehicles with three axles or more

(excluding buses)

3.10

4. Taxis 0.65

5. Buses 0.98

For the purpose of calculating the number of axles and wheels of a vehicle, the axles and

wheels of any trailer towed by the vehicle shall be calculated as part of the axles and

wheels of the vehicle.".

Deletion of First Schedule—A

4. The principal Order is amended by deleting the First Schedule—A.
